newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF to issue order to Ogawa, Daichu--paper.
newsitem.headline: MOF to issue order to Ogawa, Daichu--paper.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) is to order Ogawa Securities Co and Daichu Securities Co, financially troubled unlisted brokerages based in Osaka, to improve their operations, a business daily said on Friday.

They submitteed restructuring programmes to MOF in April but the ministry is likely to order them early next week to upgrade the plan so they can substantially improve their operations within two months, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
If they cannot comply with the order they may have to withdraw from the securities business, the paper said.
Both the brokerages are asking Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd, which is their major shareholder, for support to restructure their businesses, the paper said.
MOF was not immediately available for comment on the report.
"We have not heard anything from the financial authorities," a Daichu spokesman said.
Ogawa also has not heard anything from MOF, an Ogawa spokesman said.
